## APK testing

For each change in a pull request, the Deku Keyboard CI workflow builds a debug APK artifact. Open the [Deku Keyboard CI run](https://github.com/Deku-Foundation/deku-keyboard/actions/workflows/android.yml), download the `app-debug.apk` artifact, and test it on a device. Debug builds use the `org.deku.foundation.dekukeyboard.debug` application ID.
